title: Support access choices
decision: An administrator opens support access with a reason for 1 to 24 hours and it is active at once; one open access per administrator and shop; it allows reading the customers and their entries and nothing else; without one a read is refused with a code of its own and the attempt is audited; the owner is told at opening and closing, sees the history and can end it; two alert rules were added
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 51
rationale: BR-31 and REQ-059 name the reason, the limit and the owner's visibility, not what exactly may be read
